## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5); major divergence across large-cap names suggests a transitional tape rather than a clear directional regime.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +31.41%). Materials and Energy follow: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +15.06%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Real Estate and Consumer Staples lag: SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -10.50%), PLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -1.50%), MO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -8.71%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +18.32%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.92% | 1M: +18.14%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%), KHC CORRECTION (1W: -5.64% | 1M: +0.32%), RCL CORRECTION (1W: -4.94% | 1M: +7.93%), GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +0.10%). Weakness concentrated in select defensives and real estate.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), SHOP (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%), NEM (1W: +22.95% | 1M: +23.06%). Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA showing 1W/1M sign mismatch) — tactical, not a clear broad breakout.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is strong but internally mixed; PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%), GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +0.10%). Sector 1W: +7.50% (24 stocks) — momentum favors growth names but dispersion rising.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are modestly positive with select leaders: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +6.93%) while V CORRECTION (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.54%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +6.92%). Sector 1W: +0.42% (20 stocks) — cautious tilt toward selective financial cyclicals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing leadership concentration: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.86% | 1M: +3.65%), AMGN ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.12% | 1M: +14.81%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +1.88%) vs UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -3.74%). Sector 1W: +2.79% (17 stocks) — selective strength around drug/device winners.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Growth/Momentum names (PLTR, SHOP, NOW, PANW, NVDA) while reducing exposure to lagging Real Estate/Utilities and weak defensives (CVS, PLD, SRE). Given NEUTRAL regime and MAJOR divergence, position sizing should be tactical and selective.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.86% | 1M: +3.65%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%). BEARISH: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -3.74%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.50%), Materials (1W: +5.20%), Energy (1W: +3.17%) — watch dispersion. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.92%), Real Estate (1W: -1.31%), Consumer Staples (1W: -0.28%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1,200 resistance (ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.12%)) — reclaim above to confirm continuation; AAPL 170 support (RECOVERY (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -2.15%)) — hold for stabilization; JPM 200 breakout (ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +6.93%)) would confirm financial strength; CVS 60 support (BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%)) — break deeper signals extended weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +1.88%) — FDA win headline confirms price strength. XOM (+60): XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +15.06%) — Q2 beat and buyback headlines confirm accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-60): TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +2.73% | 1M: -18.85%) — negative sentiment but short-term bounce, divergence to monitor. UNH (-55): UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -3.74%) — political scrutiny aligns with price weakness. AAPL (-50): AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -2.15%) — downgrade-driven negative sentiment while short-term bounce continues. CVS (-50): CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -7.57%) — headline-driven selling confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style. PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.46% | 1M: +38.20%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +32.62% | 1M: +26.64%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.86% | 1M: +3.65%) showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL/META/TSLA in RECOVERY vs GOOGL/AMZN in CORRECTION) and headline-driven moves (TSLA, CVS) that can quickly rotate leadership.
